item.text:
`get_relevant_context` currently does BM25 retrieval over `search_records`, not `search_classes`: it scores each record using `rdfs:label` weighted `2.0` plus the record description weighted `1.0`, then ranks and returns the top-k matches. There is no absolute relevance floor; zero-term matches are excluded by the search itself, and the no-topic path still falls back to list-all via SPARQL.

Source: **“get_relevant_context topic search: search_records (BM25 over label + description) replaces search_classes (label-only)”**
